# Fixture: detailed idea

**From:** the support lead, after the October contact-reason review.

Across the last eight weeks, "pause or skip a delivery" was the third most common
contact reason for Example Co's meal-kit subscription — about 1,900 contacts, roughly
11% of volume. Exit-survey data shows 34% of cancelling subscribers chose "I'm away
or too busy some weeks" as their main reason. Today the only way to skip is to
contact support before Thursday noon; after that the box ships.

Subscribers on the weekly plan are the affected group; the fortnightly plan has a
self-serve skip already, and its cancellation rate is about a third lower, though
the plans attract different customers.

We think a self-serve skip on the weekly plan, available up to the Thursday cutoff,
would cut those contacts and some cancellations. We would know it worked if
skip-related contacts fall and the twelve-week retention of weekly subscribers rises.

Unknowns: how many people would skip instead of staying (revenue risk), and whether
the warehouse can absorb late changes near cutoff.

(Expected mode: Thorough.)
